Job Summary

The National Partner Manager serves as Westfield's primary relationship leader for our largest and most strategically important national distribution partners, including agency networks, aggregators, financial institutions, and private equity-backed organizations with complex agency structures. This highly visible role is responsible for developing executive-level partnerships, aligning enterprise and partner strategies, and driving profitable growth across Westfield's Standard Lines business segments.

Working closely with senior leaders across Distribution Management, Underwriting, Product, Operations, and other enabling functions, the National Partner Manager influences strategic direction, identifies emerging market opportunities, and provides leadership across some of Westfield's most significant distribution relationships. The role serves as the strategic owner of the partner lifecycle, providing executive engagement, growth planning, governance oversight, performance stewardship, and issue resolution across corporate, regional, and local stakeholder groups.

Through business development, market intelligence, and cross-functional leadership, the National Partner Manager helps ensure alignment between Westfield's business strategies and partner objectives while creating long-term value for both organizations. This role plays a critical part in shaping how Westfield competes, grows, and strengthens relationships with some of the most influential organizations in the insurance distribution marketplace.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead and strengthen executive-level relationships with a portfolio of Westfield's most strategic national distribution partners, including agency networks, aggregators, financial institutions, and private equity-backed organizations.
  • Develop and execute partner growth strategies that align partner objectives with Westfield's business priorities and profitable growth goals.
  • Serve as the strategic owner of assigned partnerships, providing leadership across executive engagement, performance stewardship, governance, and relationship lifecycle management.
  • Identify, influence, and capitalize on opportunities to expand business, increase market presence, and strengthen long-term partner value.
  • Lead strategic business planning and performance reviews, utilizing data and market insights to drive results across business segments and optimize partner performance.
  • Collaborate with leaders across Distribution Management, Underwriting, Product, Operations, and other business functions to ensure enterprise alignment and a coordinated partner experience.
  • Provide market intelligence and strategic insights regarding distribution trends, agency consolidation, private equity activity, and emerging opportunities within the insurance marketplace.
  • Facilitate governance and accountability processes that support effective partnership management, risk oversight, and compliance with company standards.
  • Represent Westfield as a trusted advisor, influencing strategic decisions and strengthening relationships with senior leaders across partner organizations.
  • Manage budgets and partnership investments responsibly while ensuring alignment with business objectives.

Job Responsibilities

  • 10+ years of experience in Sales, Distribution Management, or a related field.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, Sales or a related field and/or commensurate work experience.

raw.title: SVP, Email Product Area
raw.excerpt: ABOUT SINCH Sinch’s vision is to connect every business with every customer, everywhere in the world.
raw.description:
ABOUT SINCH

Sinch’s vision is to connect every business with every customer, everywhere in the world. More than 200,000 businesses rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email. Whether customers need to verify users, deliver critical notifications, or build rich omnichannel engagement, Sinch makes it easy to connect reliably and securely at every step of the customer journey.

At Sinch we Dream Big, Win Together, Keepit Simple, and Make it Happen. These values are our foundation.

DESCRIPTION

Sinch Mailgun is one of the most important product areas within Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud. Mailgun helps businesses send, validate, test, optimize, and analyze email at scale through an API-first platform built for developers, marketers, platforms, and enterprise senders.

We are looking for an SVP of Email to lead Mailgun end-to-end as a senior product and engineering leader with clear business accountability. You will own the strategy, roadmap, execution, team health, and commercial outcomes for Mailgun, working closely with sales, marketing, customer success, finance, operations, security, compliance, and regional teams to accelerate growth, improve customer experience, and establish Mailgun as Sinch’s standard for enterprise-grade email. A core part of the mandate will be to build and drive the plan to bring Email into Sinch Build as a Sinch Email offering powered by Mailgun, making email easier to discover, adopt, integrate, and expand as part of Sinch’s broader developer and customer communications platform.

The Mandate

This role has a clear mandate: make Mailgun the center of Sinch’s Email strategy, scale it as a durable growth business, and bring Email into Sinch Build as a first-class product experience. The SVP of Email will need to simplify the portfolio, sharpen the product and platform strategy, improve the customer journey, drive stronger commercial outcomes, and build the operating discipline required for enterprise-grade scale.

What you’ll do

  • Set the Email strategy and operating model. Own the vision, strategy, priorities, investment choices, and operating rhythm for Mailgun across Send, Optimize, Validate, Inspect, related platform capabilities, and the Email on Acid transition.

  • Lead product, engineering, and platform execution. Build and develop high-performing teams with clear ownership, strong execution discipline, technical excellence, and a culture of customer focus. Balance growth, platform modernization, reliability, security, scalability, technical debt, and delivery predictability.

  • Bring Email into Sinch Build. Build and execute the product, technical, commercial, and go-to-market plan to make Sinch Email, powered by Mailgun, a first-class offering in Sinch Build for developers, platforms, and enterprise customers.

  • Drive growth and commercial performance. Own the product area’s performance across revenue growth, gross profit, margin, pricing and packaging, product-led growth, customer adoption, retention, expansion, and enterprise growth. Use data to understand funnel performance and make clear trade-offs across self-service, sales-assisted, partner, and enterprise motions.

  • Strengthen Mailgun’s market position. Define how Mailgun wins as an API-first email platform for reliable delivery, validation, quality assurance, deliverability intelligence, observability, and optimization at scale.

  • Simplify and unify the customer experience. Create a more cohesive experience across sending, deliverability, testing, analytics, onboarding, account management, billing, support, and cross-product workflows. Make it easier for customers to discover, buy, onboard, use, expand, and integrate Mailgun.

  • Partner deeply with go-to-market teams. Work closely with sales, marketing, customer success, partnerships, finance, operations, and regional teams to sharpen positioning, improve conversion, strengthen pipeline contribution, support strategic accounts, and improve expansion and retention.

  • Build for enterprise scale, trust, and compliance. Ensure Mailgun has the architecture, security, reliability, data governance, compliance, deliverability operations, and operational discipline required for global enterprise customers and high-volume senders.

  • Expand the ecosystem. Build growth through developer channels, MarTech integrations, marketplaces, embedded product motions, strategic partnerships, and native integration with broader Sinch experiences.

  • Use data to run the business. Establish and manage clear operating metrics across acquisition, activation, conversion, usage, deliverability, retention, expansion, customer satisfaction, reliability, cost, and unit economics.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 12–15+ years across product management, engineering leadership, and business leadership, with meaningful time in senior executive roles.

  • Experience leading both product and engineering teams, with accountability for full product delivery from strategy through execution, operations, and product performance.

  • A track record scaling SaaS, API-first, developer platform, or communications products across self-service, product-led growth, enterprise sales, and partner-led motions.

  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience with P&L ownership, pricing and packaging, gross margin improvement, portfolio investment decisions, and resource trade-offs.

  • Deep customer orientation and strong instincts for developer experience, onboarding, activation, deliverability, reliability, retention, and expansion.

  • Experience operating in complex, global, cross-functional environments with distributed teams and multiple regional go-to-market motions.

  • Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to align senior stakeholders, represent Sinch with strategic customers and partners, and make complex trade-offs clear.

  • Proven ability to lead through change while maintaining urgency, clarity, accountability, and team health.

Nice to have, but not required:

  • Background in email infrastructure, deliverability, email marketing, CPaaS, customer engagement, developer platforms, MarTech, or adjacent SaaS markets.

  • Experience leading branded portfolios through integration, modernization, consolidation, or migration.

  • Experience with AI-enabled analytics, automation, recommendations, observability, or performance optimization products.

  • Experience building ecosystem, marketplace, partner, or embedded product motions.

  • MBA or equivalent business leadership experience.

Who you are

You are a product and engineering leader who thinks like a general manager. You are energized by scaling mission-critical SaaS businesses, building strong technical teams, simplifying complex customer journeys, and turning product platforms into durable growth engines.

You bring ambition without unnecessary complexity. You understand the needs of developers, marketers, enterprise senders, platforms, and partners. You can move comfortably between strategy, product detail, engineering trade-offs, deliverability performance, commercial outcomes, and organizational leadership. You know how to make hard trade-offs, build trust across functions, and mobilize teams around a practical plan.

You combine strong commercial acumen, energizing people leadership with an eye for talent building a high performing team of “A-players”, strong strategic intuition, hands-on operational drive, strong operational mindset, “productive impatience”, while working with a clear long-term perspective.

OUR HIRING PROCESS

We are looking for smart and creative people who are interested in helping businesses develop cutting-edge energy management strategies and to navigate the energy transition. Successful candidates must be self-starters and entrepreneurs who are committed to delivering superior energy advice to companies that are faced with a variety of complex energy challenges that include volatile market prices, reliability, and the need to meet aggressive carbon reduction targets.
This job posting is for candidates who live in: NY, PA, MA, NJ, MD, CT, DE, RI, IL, TX, OH, or NH. If you live in CA, please apply to our California job posting

What you'll be doing:

  • Prospecting and Lead Generation: You will identify and cultivate potential clients through proactive outreach, cold calling, and leveraging networking opportunities. This is a HUNTING sales role.
  • Relationship Building: Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with clients, develop long-term partnerships and ensure customer satisfaction and renewals.
  • Client Consultations: Meet with clients to understand their energy needs, risk tolerance, and identify how 5 can best serve them.
  • Continuously Learning: You will need to stay informed about industry trends, market conditions, and competitor offerings to identify opportunities and maintain a competitive edge.
  • Sales Presentations: You will compose and deliver compelling sales presentations, effectively communicating the benefits of energy products and services to potential clients, while maintaining an executive-level presence.
  • Negotiation and Closing: Skillfully address client concerns and objections, with the ultimate goal of closing sales and achieving revenue targets.
  • Collaboration with Teams: Collaborate with internal teams, such as but not limited to operations and management, to ensure a seamless customer experience and align sales strategies with overall business goals.
  • CRM Management: Use Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools to track leads, manage accounts, and optimize the sales process for efficiency and effectiveness. The main CRM we use is HubSpot.

What you'll bring:

  • 3 or more years’ experience in the energy industry (retail gas and/or electricity, sustainability, solar, demand response, etc.) or an industry that easily translates.
  • 3+ years of experience in B2B outside sales
  • Experience identifying new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, and other channels.
  • Succeed with a high level of autonomy while embracing a team-oriented sales process, displaying resilience and unwavering determination in pursuit of success.
  • Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively within a team, yet independently drive sales initiatives, contributing to both individual and collective success.
  • Ambition, passion, teamwork, and grit
  • BA/BS degree preferred.

What You Can Expect from 5

Expect to be challenged. Expect to be supported. And expect to go to work each day with like-minded people who want to help others. A world-class team of energy and sustainability experts to help you and your clients.
Internal partners committed to helping you succeed through support and resources to provide the best possible customer service and sales experience.
Base plus commission with uncapped earning potential
Award winning culture
LI-AV1
LI-Remote

Values

Communicate Openly and Honestly - We foster a culture where everyone, from intern to CEO, can speak openly. Clear communication builds trust, drives better decisions, and keeps us grounded.
Define Excellence - Excellence means constantly pushing to be better, to lead, and to set the bar for others. We don’t settle. We evolve, improve, and shape the future of our field with every decision we make.
Do the Right thing - Integrity is why 5 was founded. We hold ourselves to the highest ethical standards, with zero tolerance for less. Our reputation is our brand, and we’re relentless in protecting it, without compromise.
Have Fun – Fun means finding joy in learning, tackling challenges, and pushing past our comfort zones. It’s the satisfaction that comes from doing hard things with great people and not taking ourselves too seriously along the way.
Make an Impact - We started 5 because people deserve better. It’s what drives us each day, to make a difference for a colleague, client, or our community. This value reminds us that our work should always make life better for someone.

Why 5?

As our name suggests, 5 isn't like other places to work. Our goal has been to build a culture where we compete against what is possible. To do this, we’ve assembled a team of smart, fun, passionate, and hard working people. At 5, we have engineers, commodity traders, sustainability experts, coders, energy analysts, business development professionals, financial professionals on the team... And we are always looking for more stunning colleagues. If you want to make a difference in your career and for other people, we should talk.

raw.description:
Tech Customer Support Administrator

At Sinch, we are a global leader in providing cutting-edge communication platforms, enabling businesses to connect with any mobile phone on the planet in seconds, or less. Our platform supports mobile SMS, rich messaging, voice, and video communication solutions for some of the biggest companies in the world.

The Tech Customer Support Administrator is a key member of Sinch global support team dedicated to ensuring the success of Sinch’s Voice and Verification customers. In this technical 2nd line service role, customer focus is central. You will be the trusted technical point of contact for complex issues, service management, and advanced routing configurations that are critical to our customers' success.

This position goes beyond traditional support; you will act as a service delivery champion, taking ownership of technical challenges and seeing them through to resolution. You will investigate and troubleshoot issues escalated from the 1st line team, manage service incidents, and ensure the quality and stability of our global traffic. Your role will involve configuring backend systems, analyzing traffic patterns, and collaborating closely with engineering and operations teams to resolve deep technical problems.

The ideal candidate has a strong technical aptitude and a passion for problem-solving. You are eager to develop a deep understanding of our business, our industry, and the complex products that power global communications. You will have the opportunity to not only solve immediate customer issues but also to collaborate with sales and product teams to enhance the customer experience and help our clients maximize the value they get from our services.

You are analytic, have a technical background, and love the challenge of digging into problems. You are driven, have no problem multitasking, and get inspired by being part of a team and company under development.

This role is open to candidates located in the Philippines, Malaysia, or China.

Job Responsibilities

Customer support & Incident Management

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for all technical support issues related to Sinch’s Voice and Verification services.
  • Identify, manage, and resolve complex customer issues, responding to technical inquiries and fulfilling service requests with a high degree of ownership.
  • Investigate and resolve service provider complaints, including issues related to fraudulent traffic patterns and traceback requests.
  • Champion initiatives to enhance the customer experience by providing data-driven feedback and guidance to internal stakeholders across the business.

Service Quality & Routing Management

  • Proactively monitor and analyze global traffic to ensure optimal routing, service quality, and performance.
  • Manage and optimize routing configurations based on quality, cost, and performance metrics, with a strategic focus on key customers and markets.
  • Administer customer account configurations, including number management, pricing implementation, and traffic routing rules.

Operational Excellence & Automation

  • Develop and maintain critical operational tools, including traffic dashboards, system alarms, and procedural runbooks.
  • Analyze daily performance data to proactively identify, investigate, and resolve potential service-impacting issues.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for automation and increased operational efficiency to elevate service delivery standards.

Who are you?

At your core, you are a curious and analytical thinker who genuinely enjoys the challenge of a technical investigation. You have a positive, "can-do" attitude and find real satisfaction in not just solving a problem, but in seeing a customer thrive because of your help. For you, being part of a global team isn't just a job detail—it's an opportunity. You are excited by the idea of working with colleagues from all over the world and believe that different perspectives are key to personal and professional growth. 

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in a technical customer support or service delivery role (2nd line or higher preferred).
  • Background in the telecommunications industry, with strong, practical knowledge of SIP protocol and modern voice technologies.
  • Proven experience working with APIs, including the ability to use or build simple libraries/scripts for testing and troubleshooting.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting large, complex data sets to identify trends, troubleshoot issues, and drive decisions.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical information clearly to diverse audiences.
  • A quick learner, capable of adapting to new technologies and processes efficiently.
  • Flexible and willing to work occasional non-standard hours to support a global team and customer base.
  • Fluency in Mandarin is an advantage

What we promise to give you

  • Remote work setup
  • Birthday leave (day off on your birthday)
  • Additional vacation leave as outlined in the employee handbook
  • Health insurance coverage
  • Home internet allowance
  • Access to the Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Sinch Values

• Dream Big - We make the impossible possible by dreaming big to solve our customers’ problems and improve their businesses. Great things happen when we dare to challenge the status quo and find creative new ways to wow them. Driven by curiosity, we believe there is no such thing as failure, only continuous learning, and development. Having big, crazy, ambitious goals drives our success.

• Win Together - Great teams work faster and better together – creating meaningful impact for customers. Together as one global team, in close collaboration with our customers, we embrace diversity, meritocracy and care about every single individual. We build trust through open and honest relationships. It’s all about the team: being inclusive, respectful, and sharing our knowledge to empower all for personal growth. We collaborate, have fun and are stronger together.

• Keep it Simple - Sinch means simple and easy. It’s how we want customers to feel when dealing with us: uncomplicated, down-to-earth, and useful. Things stay simple when you are honest, open and act with integrity. Cut the fluff and talk straight! This also means spending our time and money wisely on things that really count. Eyes on the horizon, feet on the ground.

• Make it Happen - We make things happen and make them matter – for our customers and the world. We are “doers” who value getting results and don’t overthink matters. We stay accountable for our actions, apply the highest ethical standards to set ourselves apart and always deliver. If we’re not making an impact, we rethink the approach. Structure helps us, bureaucracy and excuses do not. No putting things off – let’s get it done now.

Scripps News is seeking a Senior Producer who will be responsible for managing all pre-production and daily production of assigned show(s), with a focus on live and modular content and serving as an editorial leader for Scripps News.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Oversee planning and production of live and/or modular content across broadcast and digital platforms.

  • Serve as an editorial leader — set daily editorial priorities, exercise exceptional news judgment, and ensure accuracy, fairness and standards compliance across all segments.

  • Work closely with Director of Live Content and Director of Modular Content to execute content strategy, align story selection, pacing and platform distribution.

  • Oversee guest booking and segment building

  • Manage rundowns and segment timing; communicate creative and timing needs to producers and production teams.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • 8+ years’ experience in television news or broadcast journalism, including significant live production experience.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Exceptional news judgment and editorial leadership.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable directing producers, bookers, directors and on-air talent.

  • Proven ability to manage live production logistics and complex rundowns.

  • Experience with guest booking, segment building and vetting.

  • Calm under pressure with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • May require weekend hours, irregular hours, early mornings, evenings and occasional travel.

If you are a current Scripps employee, please do not apply on this site. Please access our internal career site at Worklife > My Info > View Open Positions at Scripps.

SCRIPPS’ COMMITMENT TO A CULTURE THAT CREATES CONNECTION:

At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose.

ABOUT SCRIPPS:

As one of the nation’s largest local TV broadcasters, Scripps serves communities with quality, objective local journalism and operates a portfolio of more than 60 stations in 40+ markets. Scripps is the nation’s largest holder of broadcast spectrum. Scripps Sports serves professional and college sports leagues, conferences and teams with local market depth and national broadcast reach of up to 100% of TV households. Founded in 1878, Scripps is the steward of the Scripps National Spelling Bee and its longtime motto is: “Give light and the people will find their own way.”

raw.title: Data Architect I
raw.excerpt: Want to lead the technical design behind modernizing AccuWeather For Business — the platform that delivers AccuWeather’s data and services to more than half of the Fortune 500?
raw.description:
Want to lead the technical design behind modernizing AccuWeather For Business — the platform that delivers AccuWeather’s data and services to more than half of the Fortune 500? We are looking for a Data Architect I who combines strong platform design expertise with the judgment to assess legacy infrastructure and design an implementable, cloud-native architecture; someone who wants to own the technical direction of a critical modernization initiative without compromising the reliability enterprise clients depend on. Reporting directly to the Data Architect II overseeing AccuWeather’s data architecture function, this position will assess the legacy, on-premises infrastructure behind AccuWeather For Business and design the cloud-native architecture that will support its future. You will produce architecture and modernization design documents — including current-state assessments, target-state designs, transition and sequencing plans, and technical specifications — and work alongside engineering teams to implement key components of the architecture, while maintaining the reliability of the backend data systems that support critical data delivery services.

You will demonstrate high-level knowledge across cloud platforms and legacy enterprise systems, independently resolve complex architecture and modernization challenges, and collaborate closely with the Data Architect II and engineering teams. Your work will help modernize the technology foundation behind AccuWeather For Business, creating a more scalable, resilient, and cloud-native platform while maintaining the reliability expected by the Fortune 500 companies that depend on it.

We are open to hiring candidates to work from our global headquarters in State College, PA, USA, or remotely.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assess the legacy, on-premises infrastructure behind AccuWeather For Business, documenting current-state architecture, system dependencies, data flows, and technical debt to inform modernization priorities.
  • Design the cloud-native architecture, producing architecture designs, technical specifications, and other documentation needed to guide implementation.
  • Own the architectural direction for the modernization effort, ensuring a cohesive approach across the platform rather than individual services or components.
  • Develop a roadmap and sequencing plan that provides a practical path from the current environment to the cloud-native architecture while minimizing disruption to enterprise clients.
  • Design backend data systems to maintain continuity of critical data delivery services throughout the transition.
  • Partner with engineering and data teams to validate and implement architecture designs, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, performant, and maintainable.
  • Contribute hands-on to the implementation of architecture designs, including developing and modifying code, data models, schemas, and supporting data platform components.
  • Estimate data consumption, capacity, and infrastructure requirements, incorporating cloud infrastructure costs into architecture decisions and trade-offs.
  • Identify and document architectural and operational risks associated with modernizing a customer-facing production platform, and design appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure the cloud-native architecture addresses performance, security, scalability, resiliency, recoverability, compliance, and data residency requirements.
  • Understand system scheduling, integrations, and dependencies across the platform and incorporate them into planning and sequencing.
  • Serve as a technical point of contact for questions and decisions related to the modernization effort’s architectural direction.

QUALIFICATIONS

· Required Qualifications:

o BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, with 5+ years of experience in data or enterprise architecture, or MS with 3+ years of experience.

o High-level knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., Microsoft Azure) and cloud-native architecture.

o Demonstrated experience assessing legacy, on-premises systems and designing modern, cloud-native architectures.

o Demonstrated experience planning or supporting large-scale modernization initiatives for production, customer-facing platforms.

o Experience designing production data platforms for performance, scalability, resiliency, and recoverability.

o Experience analyzing complex system dependencies, integrations, data flows, and scheduling requirements to inform architecture and modernization decisions.

o Demonstrated experience working with PostgreSQL, including relational data modeling, schema design, and query development.

o Advanced proficiency in Python or Go, with experience developing production-quality code for data platforms or backend systems.

· Preferred Qualifications:

o Experience designing backend data platforms that support data delivery to external or enterprise clients.

o Experience evaluating technology and architecture options, including build-versus-buy decisions and alternative modernization approaches.

o Experience evaluating infrastructure requirements and costs to inform cloud architecture decisions and design trade-offs.

o Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and data governance requirements, including SOC 2 and data residency considerations.

· Skills & Competencies:

o Strong systems thinking, with the ability to design architectures that engineering teams can implement and maintain effectively.

o Excellent written communication, with the ability to produce clear, actionable architecture and technical design documentation.

o Sound technical judgment, with the ability to translate business and platform requirements into pragmatic architecture without overengineering or underspecifying solutions.

o Ability to move effectively between architecture and hands-on implementation, translating designs into working solutions in collaboration with engineering teams.

o Ability to mentor team members and help develop the architectural judgment of less experienced engineers.

o Ability to independently lead complex, large-scale architecture initiatives and drive technical decisions through ambiguity.

About AccuWeather

AccuWeather, recognized and documented as the most accurate and most used source of weather forecasts and warnings in the world, has saved over 12,000 lives, prevented injury to over 100,000 people, and saved companies tens of billions of dollars through better planning and decision-making.

Billions of people around the world rely on AccuWeather’s proven Superior Accuracy™ across our consumer digital platforms. AccuWeather.com is the #1 weather destination and one of the top 100 most-visited websites in the world, and our award-winning AccuWeather app delivers detailed real-time forecasts to millions of smartphones.

AccuWeather forecasts also appear on digital signage, in 700 newspapers, are heard on over 400 radio stations, and viewed on 100 television stations. The AccuWeather Network and AccuWeather NOW® reach an audience of over 125 million on cable and streaming platforms including DirecTV, Charter Communications - Spectrum, Verizon, Philo, Frndly TV, Comcast’s Xfinity X1 and Xfinity Stream, Roku, Xumo, Rockbot, LG, and Amazon Freevee.

AccuWeather For Business serves more than half of the Fortune 500 companies and thousands of other businesses and government agencies globally.

Dr. Joel Myers, Founder and Executive Chairman, established AccuWeather in 1962 and is considered the “father of modern commercial meteorology.” Myers, a leading creative thinker and visionary, has been called “the most accurate man in weather” by The New York Times and has been recognized as one of the top entrepreneurs in American history by Entrepreneur’s Encyclopedia of Entrepreneurs. 

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

AccuWeather is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to all applicants and existing employees and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity/expression), sexual orientation, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religion, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

AccuWeather is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please send an e-mail to and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

raw.description:
Are you passionate about dairy science and interested in using data to improve herd performance, animal health, and farm decision-making?

VAS, a URUS Group company, is looking for a Dairy Data Scientist who brings strong knowledge of dairy production and the ability to apply statistics, analytics, and programming to real-world dairy challenges.

This role sits at the intersection of dairy science, research, analytics, and technology. You’ll work with veterinarians, nutritionists, dairy scientists, farm operators, data engineers, and software teams to analyze biological, production, sensor, and operational data and turn it into meaningful insights for the dairy industry.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze dairy production, herd health, nutrition, reproduction, sensor, genomic, and operational data.

  • Apply statistical analysis and predictive modeling to identify trends, risks, and opportunities related to herd performance.

  • Support dairy research initiatives, field trials, experimental design, data analysis, and technical reporting.

  • Use tools such as Python, R, SQL, Databricks, or similar analytics platforms to explore and analyze complex datasets.

  • Help develop dashboards, reports, decision-support tools, and automated analytics.

  • Evaluate precision dairy technologies, herd-management systems, automated milking systems, IoT devices, and other emerging technologies.

  • Partner with veterinarians, nutritionists, farm managers, researchers, data scientists, and engineers.

  • Translate scientific findings and analytical results into practical recommendations for dairy operations and business teams.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Dairy Science, Animal Science, Agricultural Science, Statistics, Data Science, Veterinary Science, Biology, or a related field.

  • Meaningful academic, research, or professional experience related to dairy cattle, dairy production, herd health, nutrition, reproduction, milk production, or animal science.

  • Experience using data and statistics to answer scientific or operational questions.

  • Some hands-on programming or analytics experience with tools such as Python, R, SQL, SAS, or similar technologies.

  • Knowledge of statistical analysis, experimental design, or predictive modeling.

  • Ability to communicate scientific and analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn new data platforms and technologies.

Even Better If You Bring

  • Master’s or PhD with research focused on dairy production, animal science, nutrition, reproduction, genetics, or animal health.

  • Experience working with dairy herd-management, DHIA, sensor, genomic, or precision dairy data.

  • Experience with Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, or cloud-based analytics platforms.

  • Experience with machine learning or predictive modeling.

  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other visualization tools.

  • Peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, or technical research reports.

  • Direct exposure to dairy farm operations and an understanding of how scientific recommendations translate into day-to-day farm decisions.

Why This Role

This is an opportunity to combine dairy science with modern analytics and help solve meaningful problems affecting herd health, production efficiency, sustainability, and farm profitability.

You don’t need to arrive as an expert in every technology we use. If you bring strong dairy knowledge, scientific curiosity, quantitative skills, and some coding experience, we want to hear from you.

Having raised $170M overall to date, we are backed by some of the largest names in finance and technology, including BlackRock, Morgan Stanley, Blockchain Capital, MUFG, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Sony Finance, Banco Santander, Coinbase, among others. Securitize has also been recognized as a 2025 Forbes Top 50 Fintech company.

Before applying, we encourage you to visit us to learn more:

Website | X/Twitter | LinkedIn

About Securitize Capital

Securitize Capital is a registered investment adviser and investment manager focused on bringing traditional investment products on-chain through tokenization.

Securitize Capital currently serves as investment manager to eight investment funds spanning private equity, private credit, CLOs, high-yield credit and other alternative investment strategies. Our funds combine traditional investment management and fund infrastructure with blockchain-based ownership and transaction capabilities, providing a unique opportunity to help build the operational framework for the next generation of investment products.

We are seeking an Associate, Fund Operations to support the day-to-day operations of Securitize Capital's investment funds and help build scalable operational processes as the platform continues to grow.

What You'll Do

The Associate will work closely with the Securitize Capital team and a broad group of internal and external partners, including fund administrators, auditors, tax providers, custodians, transfer agents, sub-advisers and other service providers.

Responsibilities will include:

Fund Operations & Financial Oversight

  • Review daily, monthly and quarterly fund financials, NAV calculations and supporting reports prepared by fund administrators.
  • Review fund-level activity, including subscriptions, redemptions, investment activity, cash movements, expenses, management fees and expense accruals.
  • Assist with cash and liquidity management across the funds.
  • Help identify and resolve NAV, accounting, reconciliation and operational discrepancies.

Fund Accounting, Audit & Tax

  • Coordinate with third-party fund administrators on accounting and financial reporting matters.
  • Support annual fund audits, including coordinating information and responding to requests from auditors.
  • Coordinate with tax preparers on annual tax filings, investor tax reporting and related information requests.
  • Assist with the review of audited financial statements and other periodic fund reporting.
  • Maintain organized records and supporting documentation for fund expenses, invoices, accruals and other financial activity.

Service Provider & Internal Coordination

  • Serve as an operational point of contact for fund administrators, auditors, tax providers, custodians, sub-advisers and other third-party service providers.
  • Coordinate across Securitize Capital and affiliated teams, including fund administration and transfer agency functions.
  • Track open operational items and ensure issues are appropriately escalated and resolved.

Tokenized Fund Operations

  • Develop an understanding of how blockchain-based fund interests interact with traditional fund accounting, custody and transfer agency infrastructure.
  • Support operational workflows involving digital assets and stablecoins, including subscription and redemption activity where applicable.

What We're Looking For

  • Approximately 2–5 years of experience in fund operations, fund accounting, asset management, fund administration, audit or a related financial-services role.
  • Experience reviewing private fund financial statements, NAVs, capital activity or fund accounting records.
  • Strong understanding of basic investment fund accounting concepts, including NAV, subscriptions and redemptions, management fees, fund expenses, accruals and cash reconciliation.
  • Strong attention to detail and an ability to independently investigate discrepancies.

Helpful Experience

Experience in any of the following would be particularly valuable:

  • Private investment funds, including private equity, private credit, hedge funds or other alternative investment vehicles.
  • Fund administration or fund accounting.
  • Investment advisers or registered investment advisers.
  • Digital assets, blockchain technology, tokenized securities or stablecoins.
  • Alternative investments such as private credit, CLOs, high-yield bonds or private equity.

Prior digital asset experience is helpful but not required. We are primarily looking for someone with strong fund-operations fundamentals who is interested in learning how traditional investment fund infrastructure can operate using blockchain technology.

Who Will Succeed in This Role

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys understanding how a fund works from end to end rather than focusing on only one part of the accounting or operational process.

You should be comfortable moving between detailed financial review and broader operational problem-solving. Whether that means reviewing a NAV, investigating a reconciliation difference, coordinating an audit request, documenting a new procedure or helping determine how a new tokenized fund workflow should operate.

Because Securitize Capital operates at the intersection of traditional asset management and digital assets, this role is particularly well suited for someone who has a strong foundation in traditional fund operations and is interested in helping build the operational infrastructure for tokenized investment products.

raw.description:
The Performance and Scale team ensures our systems remain fast, reliable, and efficient as we grow. We’re looking for a Sr. Database Performance Engineer to identify and fix slow MySQL queries across our Rails monolith, improving application responsiveness and overall system performance. In this role, you’ll take ownership of known database performance issues, use Datadog and other profiling tools to uncover high-impact optimization opportunities, and address underlying inefficiencies in query patterns or application logic. Over time, this position will expand to include performance and scalability work across other data systems such as TiDB, Elasticache, and Opensearch—directly improving user experience, enabling infrastructure efficiency, and reducing operational costs.

We're looking for someone who has built highly performant OLTP systems, who fully understands the importance and impact of efficient MySQL at scale, and who knows how to identify and focus on the areas that will have the most impact. You should be a Rails wizard who understands all the subtleties of generating performant MySQL using ActiveRecord. You should have a passion for database efficiency!

Responsibilities

  • Work hands-on to identify, analyze, and resolve slow ActiveRecord queries across the Rails monolith
  • Optimize query performance through indexing, query rewriting, and schema improvements
  • Collaborate with DBAs and other technical teams to diagnose and remediate database bottlenecks
  • Validate all performance improvements through testing, and performance measurement at high load
  • Use Datadog to analyze query performance and identify high-impact optimization opportunities
  • Implement selective caching in Redis where appropriate to reduce database load
  • Document findings and share best practices for performant query design
  • Contribute to long-term performance and scalability efforts across MySQL, TiDB, Elasticache, and Opensearch
  • Deep expertise with Ruby on Rails, able to craft elegant and minimal solutions to complex problems
  • Deep expertise with ActiveRecord MySQL query optimization — must go way beyond standard ActiveRecord use
  • Strong understanding of SQL execution and query optimization at the engine level
  • 6–10+ years of professional experience (senior level)
  • Proven ability to read, understand, and improve complex application code across large systems
  • Experience tuning queries, adding indexes, and interpreting execution plans
  • Comfortable partnering with DBAs and other technical teams to debug and resolve performance issues
  • Clear communicator who’s unafraid to ask questions or seek domain input when needed
  • Bachelor’s degree (BA or BS) or equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with alternative database technologies such as TiDB, Elasticache, Opensearch, or DynamoDB
  • Direct experience moving a Rails application to TiDB would be a huge plus
  • Opinions and practical experience regarding when to choose one database technology over another
  • Experience with query analysis and performance tooling (e.g., Datadog, Looker, K6)
  • Experience with large-scale data migrations, and tools for doing this (e.g. gh-ost)
  • Familiarity with the AWS ecosystem

What Success Looks Like

  • Methodically identify, fix, and validate known slow queries across the Rails monolith, demonstrating measurable performance improvements
  • Use Datadog to surface additional slow or inefficient queries, and partner with DBAs and the team to prioritize which to address next
  • Navigate performance work that overlaps with our ongoing TiDB implementation, balancing short-term optimizations with long-term architectural goals
  • In some cases, determine that issues are not query-related and instead require caching (Redis) or application logic changes, coordinating with code owners as needed
  • Demonstrate clear, data-driven improvements in overall database health and responsiveness during peak usage and high-load jobs

Location: Flexible/Remote (within the US)

  • 100% Remote (must be in US)
  • Base salary per year (paid semi-monthly)
  • Fast- paced and professional work culture
  • Stock options with standard startup vesting - 1 year cliff; 4 years total
  • $50 monthly communication expense stipend to go towards your phone/internet bill
  • $250 stipend to enhance your WFH setup

We are looking for Lead Consultants with expertise in Power BI, especially focusing on data quality. Power BI's core strength relies on having reliable data. Candidates should have advanced knowledge of Power BI and its components like PowerQuery/M, DAX, and dimensional modeling. Basic report design experience is also necessary. Knowledge of traditional SQL Server tools such as data warehouse design, SSIS, and SSRS, along with DirectQuery, is beneficial. Its important to understand Power BI licensing models and help clients choose the best options for their business. Experience working with the Databricks platform to build and optimize data pipelines is required. Good communication skills are essential for working with clients, their staff, and technical specialists like database developers and software engineers. The ideal candidate will have strong problem-solving skills and a good understanding of both technical and business aspects of BI. Staying updated with the latest Power BI features is also important. If you're passionate about Power BI and data, and you work well with customers, you could be a great fit.

Building efficient star schema data models, including calculated columns and measures, will be part of your work. You will develop Power BI solutions by importing data from various sources, designing reports and dashboards, and creating data elements with DAX and source queries. Guiding clients on deploying these solutions in the Power BI servicecovering gateways, DirectQuery, data flows, and refreshesis also required.

Candidates should have at least a bachelors degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Five or more years of experience working with data and BI solutions within the Microsoft ecosystem or other tools like Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Qlik, or SAP is needed. Familiarity with TSQL, data modeling, and reporting in Power BI or similar tools is important. Experience in creating comprehensive reports that include linked content, drill-downs, and nested parameters is essential. Advanced DAX skills for dynamic measures, along with data mashups and transformations using Power Query/M, are valuable. Experience with the Databricks platform for building data pipelines is also required. The ability to communicate visual choices and report interactions clearly is important. Designing user-friendly interfaces that require minimal training for end-users is part of the role. You should also be able to gather requirements and conduct focus groups to understand business processes.

Professional skills needed include a strong interest in teamwork. Excellent communication skillsboth written and verbalare necessary to work with both technical and non-technical teams. A passion for learning new technologies and a problem-solving mindset are highly desirable. The ability to adapt quickly in a fast-moving environment is also important.

Additional preferred experience includes managing Power BI tenants and workspaces for development, testing, and deployment. Skills in creating custom visualizations with Python or R in Power BI, advanced SQL including query tuning, and data quality assessment are advantageous. Experience deploying Power BI reports on-premises using Power BI Report Server or embedding reports with Power BI Embedded is a plus. Knowledge of deploying cloud-based Power BI solutions on Azure, such as Azure Data Factory, Data Lake, and SQL Database, is also beneficial.

Knowledge of deploying cloud-based Power BI solutions on Azure, such as Azure Data Factory, Data Lake, and SQL Database, is also beneficial.

You will help shape the messaging, structure the visual and copy assets, and collaborate with our design and copywriting pods to drive highly effective funnels—from awareness → engagement → lead capture → purchase → retention.

National Accounts Director – Commercial Fleet Battery Solutions

Lead the Transition from Lead-Acid to Sodium-Ion

About Our Client:

CSI is a fast-growing battery technology company and market leading provider of transportable Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), high-quality advanced battery systems for commercial electric vehicles, and low voltage batteries and electrification components to the North American commercial vehicle market. The company is focused on delivering next-generation 12V battery solutions to the commercial transportation industry. Our portfolio includes new innovative sodium-ion technology designed to improve fleet reliability, safety, sustainability, and total cost of ownership.

The Opportunity

The National Accounts Director will be responsible for developing and managing strategic relationships with the largest truck fleets, leasing companies, fleet maintenance organizations, OEMs, dealer networks, and transportation providers throughout North America. You will play a key role in introducing sodium-ion technology to a market historically dominated by lead-acid batteries while simultaneously growing established battery business across major fleet customers.

This is not a territory sales role. This is a strategic business development position focused on creating long-term enterprise partnerships with the most influential fleets in the industry.

The Ideal Candidate

We are seeking an industry veteran with established commercial fleet relationships and a proven track record in the lead-acid battery industry, selling battery, aftermarket, maintenance, or transportation solutions to the largest fleets in North America. The ideal candidate brings an existing book of business, deep knowledge of traditional battery technologies, and the ability to successfully transition customers to next-generation solutions.

This role requires someone who can effectively articulate the total cost of ownership (TCO) advantages of CSI's innovative 12V Sodium-Ion battery technology, helping customers understand the long-term operational, financial, and sustainability benefits of adopting this emerging technology.

Preferred Industry Experience: We are particularly interested in candidates with experience working for leading battery manufacturers or distributors, including Clarios, East Penn Manufacturing, EnerSys, Exide Technologies, C&D Technologies, Continental Battery Systems, Interstate Batteries, or similar organizations within the lead-acid battery industry.

This is a rare opportunity to help define an emerging battery category while leveraging existing relationships across the trucking and transportation industry.

What Makes This Opportunity Unique

Most battery sales roles focus on defending existing business. This role is about shaping the future of commercial fleet energy storage.

You will have the opportunity to leverage your existing fleet relationships to introduce one of the most promising alternatives to traditional lead-acid batteries while helping fleets reduce maintenance costs, improve reliability, and prepare for the next generation of vehicle electrification.

Key Responsibilities

•Develop executive-level relationships within major transportation fleets and leasing organizations.

•Drive adoption of both lead-acid and sodium-ion battery solutions.

•Secure national supply agreements and multi-year strategic partnerships.

•Build relationships with fleet maintenance, procurement, engineering, operations, sustainability, and executive leadership teams.

•Identify opportunities to improve fleet uptime, battery reliability, maintenance costs, and operational efficiency.

•Collaborate with distributors, truck dealers, service networks, and channel partners.

•Lead strategic account planning and executive business reviews.

•Represent the company at major industry events including:

  • American Trucking Associations (ATA)
  • Technology & Maintenance Council (TMC)
  • National Private Truck Council (NPTC)
  • Heavy Duty Aftermarket Week (HDAW)
  • Fleet and transportation industry conferences

•Provide market intelligence and customer feedback to executive leadership.

Required Experience

•10+ years of national account sales experience.

•Demonstrated success selling into commercial transportation and fleet markets.

•Existing relationships with major fleet organizations.

•Experience negotiating national contracts and enterprise agreements.

•History of exceeding sales targets and building long-term customer partnerships.

•Ability to work independently in a high-growth environment.

Highly Desired Experience

Direct experience with the following:

  • Lead-acid batteries
  • Commercial vehicle batteries
  • Fleet maintenance products
  • Heavy-duty aftermarket parts
  • Commercial vehicle electrical systems
  • Transportation technology
  • Fleet telematics
  • Truck leasing and maintenance programs

Location

•Remote within the United States with significant travel (40%) to customer sites, industry events, and strategic partner meetings.

Compensation & Benefits:

Compensation: $150,000-$200,000/ year commensurate with experience, qualifications, and location, plus uncapped commission

Benefits include:

•Medical, dental, and vision insurance

•401(k) with company matching

•Paid time off and holidays

Join us in transforming how critical infrastructure is powered by accelerating the adoption of clean, flexible, and resilient mobile energy storage solutions.

Are you an eager learner, ready to jump into technical training?

Are you looking to build core technical skills for a career in tech?

Apply to Akamai Technical Academy!

Akamai Technical Academy (ATA) (now on Pluralsight) is specifically designed to prepare individuals without technical backgrounds for a career in tech. No prior experience is required. If you are an agile learner, self-starter, and committed to spending time in training, we encourage you to apply.

About the Training

Akamai Technical Academy is a 12-week hands-on learning program offered through the platform Pluralsight. Modules are designed to help you gain foundational skills in areas such as Linux, networking, web applications, and security. As a participant, you will engage in structured learning pathways to build the confidence and competence needed for a career in tech. This training program does not constitute employment.

Important Details

  • Time Commitment: Learners will spend approximately 10 hours per week over the 12-week program duration, during flexible hours.
  • Program Dates: November 9, 2026 – February 26, 2027 (includes scheduled breaks).
  • Application Window: Applications open on October 5th and close on October 26th.
  • Non-employment: This free training program does not constitute employment.

The ATA Track (instead of job responsibilities)

Pluralsight provides a rigorous, hands-on learning experience. Completion of the program is the first step toward a potential future with Akamai. Successful graduates will be considered for a 6-month Akamai apprenticeship starting in Spring 2027, as well as any other relevant job openings at the time of completion. During the 12-week program, learners will complete 6 courses and gain the following skills:

  • Operating Systems Fundamentals: Linux, virtualization, CLI
  • Networking Fundamentals: HTTP, TCP, SSH, VPNs, troubleshooting
  • Introduction to Web Applications: APIs, HTML, CSS, AI development
  • Managing Relational Databases: SQL, database queries
  • Python Scripting Fundamentals: Python, debugging, AI coding
  • Introduction to IT Security: IoT, cryptography, network security, malware

Do what you love

To be successful in this training program, you will:

  • Be proficient in English
  • Have strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Demonstrate a strong desire to learn and ability to be a self-starter with online, self-paced learning modules
  • Be available approximately 10 hours per week from November 2026-February 2027 for online learning, hours flexible and self-determined
  • Be interested in future apprenticeship and/or job opportunities at the entry level in tech, including Network Operations, Security Architect, Technical Support, and similar roles

Working for you

Through the Akamai Technical Academy program, we will provide you with opportunities to grow, flourish, and achieve great things. Learners will gain the following benefits directly from the program:

  • Networking events with former ATA graduates
  • Visibility with hiring teams
  • Leadership connects
  • Career skills coaching
  • A guaranteed phone screen with Akamai upon completion
  • Opportunity to be considered for apprentice, intern or full-time positions

About us

Akamai powers and protects life online. Leading companies worldwide choose Akamai to build, deliver, and secure their digital experiences — helping billions of people live, work, and play every day. With the world’s most distributed compute platform — from cloud to edge — we make it easy for customers to develop and run applications, while we keep experiences closer to users and threats farther away.

Success is demonstrated through strong, people leadership, execution and governance, high‑performing TA medical leadership, trusted client relationships, and measurable delivery and growth outcomes within the assigned Therapeutic Area scope.


Summary of Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the definition of and lead execution of the global Therapeutic Area strategy, aligned to enterprise objectives and client needs.
  • Translate TA science, regulatory trends, and market dynamics into scalable medical service offerings and execution roadmaps.
  • Provide TA‑specific insights, analysis, and recommendations to support enterprise decision‑making related to investment priorities, operating model evolution, and growth strategy.
  • Serve as a senior scientific partner to clients, participating in senior client interactions and governance forums and engaging with executive stakeholders (e.g., CMO, VP Global Therapeutic Area Expertise & Delivery / Global Therapeutic Area Head, Safety, Data Management, Regulatory, Operations, Project Management and Commercial) to shape strategy and outcomes within assigned programs and accounts.
  • Lead or participate in scientific governance forums and provide medical oversight for complex or high‑risk TA activities within assigned scope.
  • Serve as a final escalation point for complex medical, scientific, ethical, and regulatory decisions, recommending risk‑appropriate actions and escalating as appropriate to the Global Therapeutic Area Head or enterprise governance.
  • Ensure consistent application of established standards for scientific quality, compliance, and integrity, balancing innovation with patient safety and data integrity, and contribute to continuous improvement of process and governance.
  • Lead and mentor senior TA medical leaders within the assigned Therapeutic Area, ensuring leadership development, succession planning, and capability continuity.
  • Coach, partner with, and advise Regional Heads of the TA medical team to align regional execution to global TA strategy, strengthen leadership capability and collaboration, and drive consistent scientific quality and high performance across geographies in coordination with TA and enterprise leadership.
  • Support and lead, as appropriate, enterprise‑wide talent, culture, and organisational effectiveness initiatives (e.g., talent reviews, succession planning, leadership development, and engagement).
  • Partner cross‑functionally with Clinical Operations, Regulatory, Commercial, Strategy, and Data teams to embed Therapeutic Area perspectives into delivery and growth initiatives.
  • Drive innovation in TA medical services, evidence generation approaches, and engagement models within assigned scope, including areas such as precision medicine, immuno‑oncology, real‑world evidence, and digital health and Advanced Therapeutics.
  • Represent Fortrea externally to strengthen the Company’s visibility and position within the contract research organization and broader medical/scientific environment through select strategic industry engagement and TA thought leadership, including publications, presentations, and panel participation at national and international scientific and industry meetings, as appropriate for the role and in alignment with enterprise positioning.
  • Support portfolio delivery through oversight of assigned programs, ensuring adherence to established quality and compliance requirements and proactively identifying and escalating risks.
  • Support service development and technical positioning within the Therapeutic Area, providing scientific and medical content for Client Engagement activities, proposals, bid defenses, and client solution development.
  • Provide clinical and scientific input to due diligence activities as a contributor, as required.
  • Own delivery excellence and scientific quality across assigned TA programs and clients, ensuring compliant, consistent execution across portfolio, aligned with global strategy.
  • Travel up to 2–3 trips per month (domestic and/or international), as required.
  • Perform other duties as needed or assigned.
  • Occasional travel to clients/site locations with occasional travel both domestic and international.

Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • MD, PhD, PharmD, or equivalent advanced scientific degree. Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience and successful project outcomes in lieu of educational requirements.

  • Demonstrated executive-level judgment and decision-making in complex, ambiguous environments.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop senior medical/scientific leaders and shape inclusive, high-performing teams.

raw.title: Sr. ITGC / IT SOX Analyst
raw.excerpt: Datavant is a data platform company and the world’s leader in health data exchange.
raw.description:
Datavant is a data platform company and the world’s leader in health data exchange. Our vision is that every healthcare decision is powered by the right data, at the right time, in the right format.

Our platform is powered by the largest, most diverse health data network in the U.S., enabling data to be secure, accessible and usable to inform better health decisions. Datavant is trusted by the world’s leading life sciences companies, government agencies, and those who deliver and pay for care.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a high-performing, values-driven team. Together, we’re rising to the challenge of tackling some of healthcare’s most complex problems with technology-forward solutions. Datavanters bring a diversity of professional, educational and life experiences to realize our bold vision for healthcare.

What We’re Looking For

As a Sr ITGC / IT SOX Analyst (GRC) within the Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) organization, you will lead implementation, remediation, and ongoing management of Information Technology General Controls (ITGCs) within our organization. This is a hands-on role suited for a self-starter who enjoys solving problems, collaborating cross-functionally, and ensuring compliance excellence in a fast-paced environment.This role will be responsible for ensuring that our IT processes and controls are maintained, compliant with regulatory standards, and aligned with best practices. This role reports to the Sr Manager of IT Assurance (Security GRC) and will work cross-functionally with IT, GRC, Information Security, Finance, and Compliance teams to address any ITGC deficiencies and assessments to drive continuous improvement in compliance programs.

What You Will Do

  • ITGC Program Execution
    • Lead and monitor ITGC testing (access, change management, computer operations, backup/recovery, interfaces).
    • Execute walkthroughs, control design assessments, and test-of-one/ongoing effectiveness procedures.
    • Validate completeness and accuracy (C&A) for key reports and data flows; assess IPE.
  • Controls Design & Remediation
    • Advise on control design and documentation (risk/control matrices, narratives, process maps).
    • Track deficiencies; partner on root cause analysis and target-state remediation plans.
    • Independently verify remediation effectiveness and maintain evidence quality.
  • Stakeholder Management
    • Coordinate with external auditors and co-sourced providers; align on scope, reliance, and timelines.
    • Communicate findings and status to management; escalate risks proactively.
  • Governance & Continuous Improvement
    • Maintain ITGC program artifacts (RACM, population and sample evidence, issue logs).
    • Contribute to controls automation, segregation of duties (SoD) governance, and periodic access recertifications.
    • Support IT policy/standard refreshes and control rationalization.
  • Assessment Execution
    • Perform end-to-end assessment: scoping, risk & control assessments, test plans, fieldwork, and reporting.
    • Assess IT processes including identity & access management, change/release management, backup/recovery, incident/problem management, vulnerability management, patching, disaster recovery/business continuity, interfaces/integrations, and data quality.
    • Perform cybersecurity-themed reviews (e.g., endpoint security, logging/monitoring, vulnerability & patch management, configuration baselines).
  • Advisory & Continuous Improvement
    • Provide practical recommendations that balance risk with operational realities.
    • Monitor remediation progress; validate closure and sustainment of fixes.
    • Support integrated audits with operational/financial teams; contribute to annual risk assessment and audit plan.
  • Reporting & Governance
    • Draft clear reports with prioritized findings, risk ratings, and management action plans.
    • Present results to stakeholders; communicate clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Maintain audit methodology and working papers to internal standards; support QA reviews.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 4+ years of progressively responsible IT General Controls experience via IT audit/assurance, SOX 404 testing, or IT risk & controls (Big 4 or industry).
  • Hands-on experience testing ITGCs and automated application controls; working with internal and external auditors.
  • Strong understanding of access management, change management, computer operations, IPE/C&A, and segregation of duties.
  • Excellent communication skills—you can explain control requirements to engineers and translate technical speak for auditors.
  • Demonstrated ability to juggle competing priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and project management capabilities.
  • Self-starter who is driven to build structure where needed.

Tool & Technology Stack:
We value familiarity with the following tools and platforms. While not all are required, exposure to these (or similar) technologies will help you succeed:

  • GRC/Audit Platforms: TrustCloud, AuditBoard/SoxHub
  • Ticketing Systems: Jira
  • Collaboration Tools: Slack, Confluence
  • Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP
  • Proficiency with common ERP systems (e.g., Oracle, NetSuite)
  • Identity/Access Governance platforms: (e.g Okta , SailPoint)

What We Offer

  • Certifications: CISA, CISSP, CIA, CPA, CRISC (one or more strongly preferred).
  • Familiarity with NIST, AICPA / SOC 1 & 2, COBIT, COSO, ITIL, PCI, or ISO 27001.
  • Technical Exposure to cloud controls (Azure/AWS/GCP), DevOps (CI/CD) controls, and data governance.
  • Automation/Scripting/Policy-as-code: Familiarity with automation tools or scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) for control testing and workflow optimization is a plus

raw.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a detail-oriented and execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Creative Designer (DTC, Direct-to-Consumer) opening.

As the Creative Designer (DTC), you will execute DTC creatives (video editing & graphic design) for ads, web, email, and organic content by translating clear creative direction into fast, consistent, and high-quality outputs. You will contribute to the growth of the company's DTC channel by creating and iterating new creatives based on feedback, while keeping all assets organized and properly stored.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Execute DTC Ad Creatives for Meta Ads

  • Edit UGC videos and branded videos following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create static creatives following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create and iterate on variations of top-performing creatives based on DTC Lead feedback and performance insights.

Execute Web and Funnel Creative Assets

  • Design visuals for website pages and landing pages (images, banners, sections, etc.), ensuring designs are clean, clear, and aligned with brand and conversion goals.

Execute Email Creative Design

  • Design and update email creatives in Figma (or similar platform) for email flows and campaigns based on provided copy and direction, ensuring clear structure, strong visual quality, and alignment with brand and campaign needs.

Execute Organic Content Editing for Instagram

  • Edit and prepare video and photo content for Instagram (posts, reels, and stories), ensuring clear structure, strong pacing, and a clean, professional, and consistent visual style aligned with brand guidelines.

Maintain Creative Asset Organization & Hygiene

  • Maintain all creative assets organized, properly named, and stored within the defined folder structure, ensuring easy access, version control, and complete, ready-to-use deliverables.

Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience creating video and image creatives for ads, social media, or e-commerce, with a basic understanding of Meta Ads (hooks, pacing, clarity).
  • 1–3 years of experience using tools such as Figma, Adobe Suite, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar, including AI tools for image and video creation.
  • 1+ years of experience following creative direction and brand guidelines and translating them into clear and consistent designs.
  • 1+ years of experience creating ads, UGC videos, or social content, or a portfolio showcasing real client or brand work, with an emphasis on clear and effective creatives rather than polished perfection.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done. Has a track record of working hard.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Strategic thinking & Visioning): able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way (determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends).
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): does not cut corners ethically, earns trust and maintains confidences. Speaks plainly and truthfully.
  • Efficiency: produces a high volume of creative assets quickly while maintaining quality and minimizing wasted effort.
  • Flexibility/adaptability: adjusts quickly to changes in creative direction, feedback, and priorities without friction.
  • Openness to criticism and ideas: often solicits feedback and reacts calmly to criticism or negative feedback.
  • Organization & Planning: keeps files, assets, and tasks well organized, ensuring easy access and clear structure.
  • Creativity / Innovation: develops variations and new ideas from top-performing creatives and DTC Lead feedback, improving and expanding existing concepts.
  • Teamwork: collaborates closely with the DTC team to stay aligned on creative direction, priorities, and execution.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct impact on DTC growth through creative execution.
  • High ownership and autonomy in day-to-day work.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a creative professional who thrives in a fast-paced DTC environment, combines speed with consistency, and is motivated by clear creative direction, performance feedback, and continuous improvement.
