Position Overview

Virtualitics is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Sales Account Executive to join our Federal Sales team and Go-To-Market (GTM) Organization. This individual will be a key driver of our growth within the Department of War(DoW), focusing on Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications that directly impact military readiness. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker, aggressive and outcome oriented, with a proven track record of selling complex AI software solutions into the DoW space and a deep understanding of the challenges facing the Dept. of War in areas of sustainment, logistics, and operational availability. Reporting directly to the Sales Director within GTM Organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Full-Cycle Sales Execution: Drive the entire sales process from initial prospecting and opportunity identification to contract negotiation and closing. Build and manage a robust sales pipeline to meet and exceed annual sales targets & Qtrly deal stage KPI’s.

  • Sales Account Management: Develop and execute comprehensive account strategies to penetrate key DoD agencies and commands. Identify key stakeholders, understand their challenges, and map our solutions to their critical readiness missions.

  • Customer Relationship Building: Establish and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with decision-makers, influencers, and end-users within the DoW.

  • Solution-Oriented Selling: Act as a trusted advisor to clients by deeply understanding their specific readiness needs across various domains, including:

    • Aircraft, ship, and ground vehicle asset availability and sustainment operations.

    • Medical device and personnel readiness of the total force.

    • Materiel storage, warehousing management, and supply chain logistics for specialized equipment.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with the Virtualitics pre-sales engineering/solutions, marketing, Acct Mgmt, and product teams to create and deliver compelling demonstrations, proposals, and RFI/RFP responses that effectively communicate our value proposition.

  • Market Intelligence: Stay current on DoD trends, procurement processes, and competitive landscape to effectively position Virtualitics' solutions.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Required:

    • 5+ years of successful experience in a quota-carrying Federal Account Executive role, with a strong preference for experience within the DoW..

    • Demonstrated experience selling enterprise software, AI/ML, data analytics, or similar complex technology solutions.

    • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic account plans and manage complex sales cycles. Strong understanding of procurement & contracting for AI software acquisition process.

    • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate a complex value proposition to a technical and non-technical audience.

    • Self-starter with the ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment.

  • Preferred:

    • Existing relationships within DoW logistics, sustainment, or readiness communities (e.g., NAVSUP, MAJCOMS - ACC, AFMC, AMC).

    • Understanding of government contracting and procurement vehicles.

    • Experience with MEDDIC/MEDPIC, Challenger, or other solution-selling methodologies.

    • Active security clearance or the ability to obtain one.

    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.


You will be required to obtain and maintain an interim and/or final security clearance. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal.

Compensation

We offer:

  • Competitive base salary based on experience

  • Lucrative Commission Plan (50/50 sales plan)

  • 100% employer paid health benefit premiums (medical, dental, vision)

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off

  • Paid Time Off for National Holidays

  • Stock options at sign-on

  • 401k plan

  • Company equipment (Mac/PC and iPhone)

  • Remote work from home


About Us

Virtualitics, the Mission AI Company, is focused on readiness applications primarily for defense and national security. We are a rapidly growing small business built on a decade of Caltech research in partnership with NASA/JPL. We transform mission readiness and operational efficiencies at speed and scale by reshaping how to approach complex data environments. Our AI solutions provide essential insights that address critical national security capability gaps within operational readiness: Maintenance, Materiel, Supply Chain, Personnel, Data Modernization and Deep Threat Analysis.

Flexible, meaningful work. Expert impact when it matters most.

At AFCA, our purpose is simple: to help Australians achieve fair outcomes when things go wrong with financial services. We're looking to appoint experienced Sessional Ombudsmen, Life Insurance to join our highly regarded decision-making team on a flexible, engagement-based arrangement.

As a Sessional Ombudsman, you'll provide specialist, on-demand expertise as part of a talented panel of senior legal professionals. Engagements can range from a few days to several months, offering you the flexibility to contribute your expertise while maintaining the balance and lifestyle that matter to you.

This opportunity is ideal for accomplished legal professionals who are looking to apply their extensive experience in a role that combines intellectual challenge, community impact and flexibility. Whether you're transitioning from private practice, stepping back from a full-time executive role, or seeking to complement an established portfolio career, you'll have the opportunity to make a genuine difference to consumers and industry alike.

Reporting to Emma Curtis, Lead Ombudsman Insurance, you'll bring significant senior-level experience in the insurance sector, particularly within life insurance and/or general insurance. You may be a highly experienced lawyer, tribunal member, regulator, ombudsman, executive leader or other legally qualified professional with a proven history of sound judgment and decision-making in complex environments.

This is a board-appointed role for a 3 year term, subject to re-appointment.

What you'll bring

You are a trusted and credible leader who:

  • Quickly synthesises complex information and identifies the issues that matter most.
  • Exercises sound judgment and delivers balanced, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Communicates with clarity, confidence and empathy across a broad range of stakeholders.
  • Works effectively both independently and collaboratively.
  • Navigates sensitive and contentious matters with professionalism and resilience.
  • Maintains impartiality while dealing with competing perspectives and challenging situations.

Most importantly, you are motivated by the opportunity to contribute to a fair, accessible and independent dispute resolution service that delivers meaningful outcomes for the community.

To be successful, you'll have:

  • Legal qualifications and substantial senior-level legal experience.
  • Significant expertise within insurance, particularly life insurance and/or general insurance.
  • A demonstrated track record of achievement within a law firm, tribunal, external dispute resolution scheme, regulatory agency, insurer or related organisation.
  • Exceptional analytical, decision-making and stakeholder management skills.
  • The ability to maintain independence and impartiality in all matters.

Please note that your business or professional dealings within the past three years must not give rise to any reasonable perception of bias in favour of consumers or financial firms.

To apply

If you’re passionate about fairness and believe your skills align with this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every single criterion.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and gender identities. If you require any accessibility support during the recruitment process, please reach out to our team at .

We believe fairness starts with people. That’s why we don’t use AI or automated tools to screen candidates. As a result, our processes may take a little longer, and we thank you for your patience.

About AFCA

The Australian Financial Complaints Authority (AFCA) was established in 2018 as a private not-for-profit ombudsman service providing free, fair and independent help with financial disputes. The original team has grown to over 1600 dedicated professionals. Since 2018, AFCA has received more than 634,000 complaints, helping to secure $2.1 billion in compensation for consumers.

AFCA is a 2026 Circle Back Initiative Employer - we are committed to responding to every applicant.

Fairness feels good

Make a real impact at AFCA. Where fairness drives every decision. Help us deliver world-class, independent complaints resolution for Australians. As a not-for-profit and progressive financial ombudsman, we’re championing positive change. Achieving our purpose takes progressive thinking, accountability and resilience. At AFCA, our inclusive leadership values every voice. We offer our people flexible work options, thoughtful benefits and opportunities to deepen expertise. Flourish in a diverse, caring culture. Feel the difference of belonging to an organisation intentionally designed to put people first.

Ajax Systems est une entreprise technologique internationale et le plus grand fabricant de systèmes de sécurité en Europe, comptant plus de 4,5 millions d’utilisateurs finaux et 330 000 utilisateurs professionnels dans plus de 180 pays à travers le monde. L’entreprise propose des solutions complètes de bout en bout pour la protection des habitations et des entreprises, quelle que soit leur taille. À ce jour, le portefeuille de produits Ajax comprend 280 dispositifs couvrant la protection anti-intrusion, la vidéosurveillance, la sécurité incendie et la protection des personnes, ainsi que le confort et l’automatisation. Ajax Systems emploie aujourd’hui plus de 5 000 collaborateurs.
Nous développons des équipes locales, convaincus que les experts sur le terrain sont les mieux placés pour comprendre les spécificités de chaque marché. L’entreprise dispose de représentants commerciaux dans le monde entier, notamment en Italie, Espagne, Allemagne, France, Royaume-Uni, États-Unis, Australie, Afrique du Sud, ainsi que dans de nombreuses autres régions. L’équipe Global Business Development est composée de profils partageant les ambitions élevées et la vision de croissance d’Ajax Systems.
La combinaison du meilleur logiciel et d’un matériel puissant a durablement transformé la perception des systèmes de sécurité, tant pour les utilisateurs que pour les professionnels du secteur. Récompensée lors des plus grands salons spécialisés tels que IFSEC, Expoprotection et Intersec, et lauréate de prix prestigieux décernés par des médias de référence comme PSI Magazine et GIT SECURITY, Ajax Systems est aujourd’hui l’un des fabricants de systèmes de sécurité les plus primés en Europe.

La sélection des composants utilisés dans la fabrication des dispositifs Ajax repose sur des déclarations des fournisseurs confirmant leur conformité aux exigences RoHS.
L’entreprise est née dans un contexte de révolution et de guerre. C’est pourquoi la résilience est au cœur de l’ADN de la marque. Lutter contre le mal en créant les meilleures solutions de sécurité et d’automatisation constitue la mission constante et inébranlable d’Ajax Systems.

raw.excerpt: ⭐ About the team:Made up of six subteams (Dashboard, Engine, Infrastructure, Integrations, Threat Research & Security), the DataDome tech team is spread across Europe and the US.
raw.description:
⭐ About the team:

Made up of six subteams (Dashboard, Engine, Infrastructure, Integrations, Threat Research & Security), the DataDome tech team is spread across Europe and the US. We handle over 2 000 billion events per day giving responses within 3ms (99p). We are present in more than 29 data centers around the world, deployed using Docker.

We deploy on AWS, Scaleway and GCP, using Docker, Ansible and Terraform, and monitor with Grafana and Prometheus. We handle an average of 8 billion requests per day and manage more than 300 TB of data per month.

When it comes to our stack, we run real-time detection layer in Java, low latency Stream Engine running on Flink in Scala, ElasticSearch for storage, Kafka for communication between layers, HAProxy for load balancing, Symfony & Angular for our dashboards. While previous experience in cyber is not a must, we'll pair you with mentors who will help you bridge the gaps. As #growth is part of our DNA, we’ll give you the resources and support you need to develop mastery.

You will integrate the Threats Research team which is responsible for constantly improving the detection capabilities through client-side technologies.

Your goal will be to challenge and improve our detection capabilities. You will integrate the Threats Research team which is responsible for constantly improving the detection capabilities through advanced algorithms and data-centric approaches.

Your goal will be to challenge and improve our detection capabilities using generative AI capabilities.

👉 You will be more specifically in charge of things like...

  • Applying generative AI to detection topics for the Threat Research teams. For example, use a crew of agents to automate traffic analysis and speed up SOC team response to requests.
  • Injecting generative AI in DataDome products for Threat Research related features like generating a detection summary based on past detection improvement.
  • Proactively looking for and develop generative AI use cases for fraud detection.
  • Collaborating with other tech teams to deliver AI powered features.
  • Building Gen AI stack at DataDome in the Cloud (AWS or GCP)

👤 It would be great if you have:

  • First experience in applied AI Engineering
  • At least 2 years of experience programming in Python
  • Strong computer science background
  • Good LLM / AI Engineering theoretical knowledge
  • A "hacker" spirit
  • Good communication skills (oral and written)

Nice to have

  • GCP VertexAI of AWS Bedrock knowledge
  • Multi agent framework (i.e. CreawAI) experience
  • Pytorch experience

What’s in it for you?

  • Flex Life: While we offer remote options our Parisian office is located next to the Opera Garnier. You will also receive a 500€ stipend to help you set up your ideal workspace.
    • If you are full remote, the SNCF dicount card is paid for you to come to our office to visit us & your team monthly!
  • Generous Health Benefits: We have partnered with Kenko for your healthcare needs.
  • A 100€ annual allowance is provided for a leisure activity of your choice in Sports or Culture.
  • Annual allowance of €200 if you come to the office by bike to cover maintenance costs.
  • Professional Development: #Weaimhigh is part of our DNA, therefore we have invested in an internal Learning and Development platform and offer the opportunity to request additional training and support via your manager.
  • Events & Team building: #We care and we have fun! We organise Annual Company-Offsite, Events, Drinks, Winter Party, Lunch & Learns and much more are part of our Culture
  • PTO: Based on the country you are based from (e.g. 25 days in France).

What are the next steps?

  • You x Talent Acquisition Manager : first interview and cultural fit
  • You x Engineering Manager : technical and cultural fit + Take-home technical challenge
  • You x Team: Presentation and review of your "technical proposal" with the team
  • You x Member of the leadership team - Discussion about DataDome vision and "raison d'être"!
  • Now you really met everyone! Welcome to DataDome :)

DataDome stops cyberfraud and bots in real time, outpacing AI-driven fraud from simple to sophisticated across your sites, apps, and APIs. Named a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Bot Management, the DataDome platform is built on a multi-layered AI engine that focuses on intent, not just identity. Because it’s not about knowing who’s real, it’s about what they intend to do. With thousands of AI models that adapt to every fraudulent click, signup, and login, DataDome blocks fraud in less than 2 milliseconds, without compromising performance. DataDome is fully automated and integrates seamlessly into any tech stack. Backed by a 24/7 SOC team of advanced threat researchers, DataDome stops over 350 billion attacks annually. Experience protection that outperforms with DataDome.

DataDome is an equal opportunity employer, and proud to be committed to diversity and inclusion. We will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability or age.

ABOUT YOU

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Responsibilities:

  • Architect and lead the design of Xsolla’s next-generation identity platform, supporting authentication, authorization, single sign-on (SSO), and account federation across internal and external services.
  • Develop high-performance Golang microservices that manage user identity, access tokens, and permission enforcement at global scale.
  • Collaborate closely with security, DevOps, and platform engineering teams to embed Zero Trust principles and standardize access governance across services.
  • Integrate modern IAM standards and protocols (OAuth2, OIDC, SCIM) to enhance developer experience and partner integrations.
  • Mentor and coach engineering teams on secure service design, identity best practices, and cross-service communication patterns.
  • Partner with product teams to ensure that identity-related features — such as player login, entitlement management, and account linking — are scalable, compliant, and user-friendly.
  • Define and enforce API and data security standards, supporting compliance initiatives.
  • Evaluate and integrate third-party identity frameworks or open-source solutions (e.g., Keycloak, Auth0, Ory, ForgeRock) as part of Xsolla’s hybrid identity strategy.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • 10+ years in backend or systems engineering, including 5+ years designing and implementing authentication and authorization services.
  • Expert-level skills in Golang, with experience building and scaling distributed, event-driven microservices.
  • Proven track record with identity federation, token management, and access control systems.
  • In-depth understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, SCIM).
  • Solid grasp of security principles, encryption, key management, and secrets management systems (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS).
  • Experience building high-availability systems in Kubernetes-based environments using AWS, or GCP.
  • Strong architectural vision with the ability to influence cross-team design and technology direction.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across distributed teams.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience building or contributing to identity systems for gaming or SaaS ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant architectures, ReBAC/ABAC models, and policy-as-code (OPA, AuthZ frameworks).
  • Background in security engineering, DevSecOps, or compliance automation.
  • Contributions to open-source Golang.
